item.title: Gunsmoke - The Pretender
item.description: The Dano brothers return home from prison to a dying mother and a bitter father.

item.title: The Waltons - The Odyssey
item.description: John-Boy seeks some solitude to write his stories, but finds a life-altering situation

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - A Thousand Pardons -- You're Dead!
item.description: An army sergeant and a municipal worker run a scam in which they use local bar women to claim G.I. widow benefits. Sgt. Simms then kills the women, motivated by both the cash and his desire to avenge his brother killed in Vietnam.

item.title: Matlock - The Verdict
item.description: Katie Clark is a hot new prosecutor in town and her first case involves the murder of one of her former lovers. Despite his reservations about Clark working the case, Matlock is impressed with her desire to not allow personal feelings affect her judgment.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Injured Innocent
item.description: After a test driver deliberately crashes a race car equipped with an experimental engine, claims the collision paralyzed him and then ends up murdered, Mason defends the investor behind the engine's creation.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Wally Stays at Lumpy's
item.description: A communication gap ensues when Wally wants to spend the night at Lumpy's and Beaver wants to have Gilbert spend the night. Beaver asks June and she tells him he can sometime when Wally spends the night somewhere and Wally asks Ward, who tells him he can sometime when Beaver has someone spend the night.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Eddie Quits School
item.description: Eddie pompously announces that he's dropping out of school to get a high paying job at a gas station. However, all is not as it seems when Wally and Lumpy get a glance at Eddie's new free spending life.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Black History - Harlem Rennaissance
item.description: Toon In With Me - Black History - Harlem Rennaissance

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 134: Child Stealer
item.description: Reed has to deal with the consequences of forgetting to roll up the window on the patrol car before he left it. Back on patrol, Malloy and Reed search for an estranged husband who kidnaps his own child, deal with an elderly man who tries to pay for a meal with trading stamps, engage in a shootout with an escaped prisoner caught napping on a city bus and pull over a hijacked delivery van full of booze.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 114: The Hero
item.description: Malloy and Reed witness a young hispanic man save a trapped watchman from a burning warehouse, but become suspicious when he resists numerous attempts of private and public commendation. They also try to prevent a drunken man from falling out a window, and resuscitate a man with a heart condition.
